# Write Primitives update_computed_column

```{tags} reference, query-template, write_primitives
```

> [Write Primitives](../../write-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Write Primitives queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
UPDATE update_ops_orders SET o_totalprice = o_totalprice * 1.1 + 50.0 - (
  o_totalprice * 0.02
), o_comment = 'computed_update'
WHERE
  o_orderkey BETWEEN (
    SELECT
      MIN(o_orderkey)
    FROM update_ops_orders
  ) AND (
    SELECT
      MIN(o_orderkey) + 50
    FROM update_ops_orders
  )
```
